facts.label: Should e past progressive
facts.sub: Use should + verbo base para conselhos e was/were + -ing para o que estava acontecendo: You should relax. I was kicking too hard.

facts.label: Conselhos
facts.sub: Para dar um conselho, use should + verbo base: You should relax your legs. Should não muda com he, she ou it e não leva to: She should practice.

facts.label: Ação em andamento
facts.sub: Para dizer o que estava fazendo, use was/were + -ing: I was kicking too hard. My eyes were hurting. Use was com I, he, she e it, e were com you, we e they.

pages.title: A public pool · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning at a public pool in Calgary. Children laugh in the shallow water. Bia sits on the edge with a wet towel. Her friend Ugo arrives with a bag. He sees her tired face. He asks about her lesson.
“Hi, Bia! How was your first swimming lesson?” says Ugo. “It was fun, but hard. I was kicking too hard and I got tired.” says Bia. “You should relax your legs.” says Ugo.
